Daily Wellness

Supplements work best alongside good everyday habits.

A day built around energy

Morning

Drink a glass of water, get some daylight, and take your Erexafil capsule with breakfast as directed on the label.

Midday

Eat a balanced lunch with protein and vegetables. Walk for ten minutes to keep your energy even through the afternoon.

Afternoon

Strength training or cardio, three to four days a week, supports stamina and a healthy circulation.

Evening

Cut caffeine late in the day, switch off screens an hour before bed and wind down. Good sleep matters a great deal for energy and drive.

Five habits that support vitality

Sleep 7–9 hours

Rest is when your body recovers. Poor sleep drains energy and mood.

Move regularly

Mix resistance training with walking or cardio.

Eat whole foods

Lean protein, fruit, vegetables, nuts and healthy fats.

Manage stress

Breathing, time outdoors and hobbies help keep stress in check.

Limit alcohol and smoking

Both can work against stamina and sexual health.

Make it a habit

The easiest way to stay consistent is to attach your capsule to something you already do, like brushing your teeth or making coffee. Set a phone reminder for the first two weeks until it feels automatic.

How to Use & FAQ

Straight answers to common questions.

How to use Erexafil

  • Always follow the serving instructions printed on your bottle.
  • Take it with a glass of water, ideally with a meal.
  • Take it at the same time each day.
  • Do not exceed the recommended serving.
  • Store in a cool, dry place with the cap tightly closed, away from children.

Frequently asked questions

What is Erexafil?

Erexafil is a dietary supplement for men, made to support vitality, stamina, libido and energy.*

How many capsules are in a bottle?

Packaging shows 30 capsules in the standard bottle (some formats list 60). Check your label for the serving size.

How long until I notice a difference?

It varies. Supplements usually need steady use over several weeks, combined with healthy habits.*

Is Erexafil a prescription drug?

No. It is a dietary supplement and is not meant to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Who should talk to a doctor first?

Anyone with a medical condition, anyone taking medication (especially for heart conditions or blood pressure) and anyone experiencing ongoing sexual health concerns. A doctor can rule out underlying causes.

Are there side effects?

Reactions can occur with any supplement. Stop use and consult a healthcare professional if you have any adverse reaction. Review the full ingredient list for allergens.

What is the guarantee?

Packages come with a 60-day guarantee. See the order page for the full terms.

Which package should I pick?

One bottle is about a 30-day supply. Larger packages cost less per bottle and are popular with men who want to stay consistent.

How is my order shipped?

Shipping is charged on the 2-bottle package and free on the 3- and 6-bottle packages. Orders are placed securely on the order page.
